---
title: "Leipnik-Newton System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& -x+y+yz\\
\dot{y} &=& ax-y+xy\\
\dot{z} &=& z-xy
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-32$ and initial condition $(-1,5,-2)$.
